system: Wild & Wandering PMS Backlog & Feature Registry

features.title: Housekeeping Status Matrix & Bed Turnover Tracking
features.description: Real-time room and bed cleanliness tracker (Dirty, Cleaning in Progress, Clean, Inspected) with staff assignments and SMS/Telegram alerts for turned beds.

features.title: On-Site Multi-Currency Cash Drawer & Till Reconciliation
features.description: Shift opening and closing cash counts, petty cash logs, change calculators, and automated discrepancy reporting per front-desk staff member.

features.title: Automated OTA Promotion & Deal Margin Guardian
features.description: Simulates Net Margin impact before activating Booking.com Genius, Agoda Flash Sales, or Airbnb promotions, alerting if ADR drops below floor.

features.title: Automated Multi-Channel Guest Messaging (WhatsApp / Email)
features.description: Automated pre-arrival guides, Full Moon Party boat schedules, check-in instructions, and payment request links triggered by reservation status changes.

features.title: Bar, Restaurant & Tour Tab Integration
features.description: Charge beer, tours, motorbikes, and laundry directly to guest folios using digital signature slips or QR codes at on-site venues.

features.title: Dynamic Demand Forecasting & Shoulder Curve Optimizer
features.description: Machine learning algorithm evaluating pace, pickup rate, local holiday calendars, and flight prices to automatically shift rates for event shoulder dates.

features.title: Thai Police Bureau & TM30 Real-Time API Dispatcher
features.description: Direct automated XML/JSON payload transmission to the Thai Immigration Section 38 portal via cloud workers, replacing manual CSV batch uploads.

features.title: Granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & PIN Authorization
features.description: Permission tiers (Owner, Manager, Front Desk, Volunteer) with manager PIN prompts for folio deletions, manual rate overrides, and cash refunds.

features.title: Smart Lock & Keyless RFID Bunk / Room Access
features.description: Integration with TTLock / Tuya smart door locks generating time-bound digital PINs or NFC wristband keys upon guest check-in.

features.title: Universal Commercial Spreadsheet & CSV Ingestion Wizard
features.description: Commercial multi-format onboarding wizard with interactive column mapping (Guest, Check-in, Check-out, Payout) and dynamic room-to-bunk visual assigner.

features.title: Two-Way Direct OTA Extranet Messaging Drawer
features.description: In-folio live chat interface allowing front-desk staff to read and reply to Booking.com, Airbnb, and Agoda guest messages via Channex API webhooks.

features.title: Configurable Operational Lifecycle & Event Confirmation Pills
features.description: Convert hardcoded event buttons (SENT: FMP, PRE/POST: CONF) into property-configurable custom lifecycle pills in Setup Wizard Step 1 for festivals, surf camps, and high-demand events.
